modalAbortMatch.title: Do you really want to abort the game?
modalAbortMatch.text: The game will be permanently aborted and cannot be resumed. Are you sure you want to continue?

historyEmptyState.title: No matches found
historyEmptyState.text: No matches have been played yet. Start a new game to see the results here.

modals.deleteMatchText: Are you sure you want to delete this match?

bullOffActiveNextPlayer.title: {{FIRST_NAME}}, it's your turn!
bullOffActiveNextPlayer.helpText: Try to throw as close to the bullseye as possible. The player who is closest to the bullseye starts the first leg.

bullOffFinished.title: Bull-Off finished!
bullOffFinished.helpText: Now order the players in the correct sequence to start. The player who was closest to the bullseye starts the first leg.
